workload: Pokémon Stadium Ice Climbers mirror, two scripted ordinary human controllers on native logic frames, black decorative backdrop, low-detail models, blockmerge and animation fusion
method: One saved Stadium match checkpoint, 35-second warmup and 35-second distinct-visible-image measurement per 200/150/150/200 leg. All legs use the corrected WebGL depth path and 960x720 output; rendererDiagnostics verifies EFB dimensions after each restore.
decision: Both modes fail the 720p60 gate and paired directions disagree. Leave internal 2x unchanged for the playable default. A 43.75% EFB-pixel reduction cannot explain the entire 9+ FPS gap on this heavy Stadium scene.
limits: The 1.5x independent trial booted in another fresh browser session and is not a causal control.
